author: Cptnwhizbang
body: That's a T7+ class line called summoner. You can unlock him by talking the the NOC Horus. He looks like he has white wings and spawns randomly around the world. He's common enough if you look around a while with some vision distance on.

author: Fluid_Pie_9428
body:
As many have already pointed out, this is a "Summoner" class, part of the "Elysian" class tree that requires you to find and complete a few quests from an NPC "Horus"

You can bring up to 5 summons at the sacrifice of not being able to use a follower
